d:
The Curse of Spooky Island follows Andras, a daemon granted the body of a college girl named Lena, who is tasked with impersonating her to her friends and classmates to complete his sacred mission. Follow as Andras, forced to live amongst them, begins to discover what it means to be human. Art by Valk_yrain.

If you'd like to read more, you can read 6 months ahead for just $3 on any of my sites!

Sign up to read ahead here: https://www.patreon.com/PossessionHub
Also on Subscribestar: https://subscribestar.adult/possessionhub

There are also (at the time of writing) two exclusive prequel comics that expand the story, you can find these on the above platforms:

Spooky Island Chronicles: Sacred Mission – Set right before the main series, follow the moment Lena is captured and Andras is granted her body.

Spooky Island Chronicles: A Vision, A Body and A Lie – Taking place years earlier, uncover how the demon queen’s long-laid schemes created Spooky Island and set the stage for everything to come.
